explication_en: Two images are built: vllm with its ESIMD kernels and multi-GPU patches, and omni with the ComfyUI-OmniXPU plugin that calls the C++ kernels of omni_xpu_kernel. Prometheus and Grafana in vllm/monitor are used to monitor performance.
